title: A JEPA Recipe for Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.25541v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models learn to predict cell values in context, whereas world-model self-supervision asks for prediction in representation space (LeCun, 2022; Assran et al., 2023). On a tabular foundation-model prior, the latent term of a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) collapsed in our earlier runs and took the encoder with it to a constant map. We report a recipe under which the latent term survives to convergence beside the value objective: the value head reads the encoder field rather than the predictor, and the target is an exponential moving average (EMA) difference. To bound its cost against the value-only arm, both arms train until a plateau rule stops them, with no fixed step budget. A fixed horizon had confounded a slowdown with a ceiling, since the value-only arm was still improving well past the usual budget. At convergence, in one run per arm, the JEPA arm trails the value-only arm across 147 real datasets,

translated_title: 表格基础模型的JEPA训练配方
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型学习在上下文中预测单元格的取值，而世界模型式的自监督学习则要求在表示空间中进行预测（LeCun, 2022; Assran et al., 2023）。在表格基础模型先验之上，我们早期的运行中联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的潜在项发生了坍缩，并连带将编码器拖入常值映射。我们报告了一种配方，使潜在项能够在数值预测目标旁边存活并训练至收敛：数值头直接读取编码器的输出场而非预测器的输出，且训练目标是指数移动平均（EMA）差值。为了相对于仅数值分支公平地限定其训练成本，两个分支均训练至平台停止规则触发为止，不设固定步数预算——固定的训练轮数曾将训练减速误判为性能上限，因为仅数值分支在常规预算之外仍在持续改进。在收敛时，每个分支各运行一次，JEPA分支在147个真实数据集上整体落后于仅数值分支。
tldr: 本文提出一种让JEPA潜在项在表格基础模型上避免坍缩并训练至收敛的配方（数值头读取编码器输出、采用EMA差值目标及平台停止规则），但实验显示JEPA分支在147个真实数据集上仍落后于仅数值预测分支。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a recipe—having the value head read the encoder field, using an EMA-difference target, and stopping by a plateau rule—that prevents JEPA's latent term from collapsing on tabular foundation models, yet the JEPA arm still trails the value-only arm across 147 real datasets at convergence.
